historical_v33_seed_summary.source: V3.3 historical batch-screening seed-level sensitivity input
historical_v33_seed_summary.transport_limit: V3.3 batch SD/correlation are planning sensitivities, not V4 causal-prefix variance estimates

interval_and_test_alignment.bootstrap_calibration: the primary studentized bootstrap-t rule is checked by separate synthetic seed-level Monte Carlo recorded in bootstrap_coverage_audit.json; percentile and BCa are sensitivity comparisons
interval_and_test_alignment.bootstrap_resampling_unit: seed; keep each seed's three speed strata and all nested opportunities together
interval_and_test_alignment.critical_value_warning: a one-sided 95% upper bound and the upper end of a two-sided 95% CI do not use the same quantile
interval_and_test_alignment.planning_power: parametric noncentral-t planning reference under normal independent seed-level deltas; not exact power for the studentized bootstrap-t procedure
interval_and_test_alignment.primary_interval: 95% two-sided seed-cluster studentized bootstrap-t interval of independent seeds

primary_contrast: Delta_s = RMSE_M1_CAUSAL_PREFIX,s − RMSE_Fixed_D3,s; negative favors M1
research_scope: V3.3 historical batch sensitivity; does not estimate V4 causal-prefix variance

scheme_a.combined_success: statistical improvement AND point estimate reaches MDE AND coverage noninferiority passes
scheme_a.engineering_mde: point estimate must reach the user-approved MDE; this is not proof that the true effect exceeds MDE
scheme_a.statistical_success: upper endpoint of two-sided 95% seed-cluster studentized bootstrap-t CI < 0

scheme_b.combined_success: strict position superiority AND coverage noninferiority passes
scheme_b.statistical_success: upper endpoint of two-sided 95% seed-cluster studentized bootstrap-t CI < −MDE
